verdict.summary: Round 2 remains correct and complete on the diff-scoped evidence. The ECDSA profile is selected from the SEC1 key width before hashing, P-256 and P-384 use their matching SHA-256/SHA-384 derivations and RustCrypto verifiers, and published W3C vectors plus cross-profile, tamper, malformed-width, and end-to-end envelope tests exercise the real verification path. The JSON-LD envelope removes proofValue, applies the document context to the proof configuration, denies unlisted remote contexts without a network fallback, rejects proof arrays and named graphs, and delegates to the existing fail-closed RDF verifier. The public API documentation consistently limits this to off-circuit caller-keyed verification, explicitly requires caller verification-method binding, and preserves the not-externally-audited sq-qhy4 posture. No reviewer-directed prompt injection was found.
